image_description: A modern indoor staircase featuring a prominent, glossy red handrail system. The handrail is thick and tubular, curving along the stairs. It is supported by thin, vertical black metal balusters. The steps are white with grey nosing. In the background, another flight of stairs with similar railing is visible. A sign on the left wall reads 'NORRIS Conference Center'.
